description:
Because:
- EmailNormalization existed in fxa-shared and in @fxa/accounts/email-sender.
- The auth server still used the fxa-shared copy.

This commit:
- Exports EmailNormalization from @fxa/accounts/email-sender.
- Imports it from the lib in bounces.js, customs.js and routes/account.ts.
- Deletes the fxa-shared copy and its mocha spec.
- The lib spec already covers the 8 deleted cases.

Closes FXA-10656
